means.QUARANTINE: It waits for quality to release it: nothing of it is issued yet.

means.RETURNED: Sent back to the supplier: nothing of it was used.

split.label: Label
split.hidesLabel: Hides of the family in stock
split.noHides: No hide of the family is in stock
split.noHidesBody: Only hides in stock move into a child lot.

hide.notWhole: Only a whole hide moves to another lot ({ref}).
hide.nothing: It holds nothing at the site.

split.footRegroup: Each moved hide gets a new tag in its new lot.

held.notHides: Only a lot of hides is split into shade groups.
held.blocked: The lot is blocked: release or reject it before its hides are sorted.

held.refusedHide: A hide picked cannot move now: put it back.

held.longNote: The note is at most 500 characters.
held.noMove: Pick another lot of the family for at least one hide.
held.tooMany: At most 26 groups at a time.

split.failed: The split could not be made. Try again.
